caption:
What is cash-on-cash return? Your return on the money you actually put in.

Rent comes in. Costs go out. The bank takes its mortgage. What's left is your cash flow.

Cash-on-cash = yearly cash flow ÷ cash you put in (down payment + closing costs).

Same $300K house:
Paid all cash: 6.5%
With 25% down at 7%: 1.8%

It tells you what YOUR money actually earns.

Example numbers for illustration.
